notes.title: 0.9.14.0.0 Auction request. Preparation for upcoming update
notes.notes:
[p][i][b]As a temporary discount (for a week, up to and including 14.08.2025), the purchase of donation game currency for credits will be 40% cheaper.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Movement[/h3][list][*][p]Speed has been converted to fractions. Thanks to this, various weak effects on speed can give their increase without rounding to nothing. Any serious errors found related to this will be rewarded.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Auction[/h3][list][*][p]Added auction request. You can select the desired item and set a price for it. Any player will be able to see it and sell it to you.[/p][/*][*][p]Premium now gives 1 additional slot at the auction.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]General changes[/h3][list][*][p]Added the ability to preview stickers before buying.[/p][/*][*][p]Also, for convenience in buying after viewing, you can buy all missing stickers at once when trying to save them.[/p][/*][*][p]The maximum zoom of the ship in the sticker interface has been increased from x1.5 to x3[/p][/*][*][p]Changing the ship skin no longer leads to duplication of stickers (visible only to the wearer).
[/p][/*][*][p]Added 10% shield to the science ship class branch.[/p][/*][*][p]Frigates lost 4% shield and gained 3 armor.[/p][/*][*][p]Required reputation level for Siege Battleships increased from 2 to 3.
[/p][/*][*][p]Increased dust collector output in asteroid fields by 25%. The productivity penalty for the number of collectors on the station has been significantly reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Dust collectors increase damage to the station while working by ~17% (multiplicatively for each).[/p][/*][*][p]Building station modules now takes time.[/p][/*][*][p]Solar panels on the star now receive increased damage.[/p][/*][*][p]In S3, the bonus to asteroid mining has been reduced from +50% to +25%. [/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Planets with a store are now visible directly on the sector map.[/p][/*][*][p]Hover hints have been added to several interface elements.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual animation has been added to items that are given out in a quest or in crafting/processing for a better understanding of where to look to find an item/order. [/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Quests no longer show "hand in items" if there is nothing else to hand in.[/p][/*][*][p]More quests can now be taken from any point.[/p][/*][*][p]The navigation hint now correctly displays "take off from your location" if you are in the same system but not in space.[/p][/*][*][p]New options are available in quests - quests can now give out equipment for the duration of training.
[/p][/*][*][p]Added a variation of "diplomats" for bots, which give significantly more reputation when destroyed. In many ways similar to civilians and traders.
[/p][/*][*][p]Updated localization.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]Corrections[/h3][list][*][p]Items are now immediately removed from the inventory after death, visually, without misleading the player who did not close the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that did not count landing in asteroid fields in the new quest "Tour" in S2. To apply the changes, you should cancel the quest and start over.[/p][/*][*][p]The order of quests for the key to In'Nefile has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed switching the option for the visibility of skins, which did not turn on stickers again without re-entering the location.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the incorrect delay of the speed of bullets for droids.[/p][/*][*][p]Changes in the display of the time of messages in the chat.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.9.13.0.0 Sell price changes. Drone evasion. Skins.
notes.notes: [h3]Skins[/h3][list][*][p]Added option to change ship skins. Limited by ship class for visual consistency.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Changed the method of calculating the price of an item when buying/selling it, taking into account the durability and repair of the item.[/p][p]Selling/Buying no longer takes into account the repair skill, and does not apply repair modifiers (previously, the player, paying for the missing durability when buying an item, applied skills to reduce the cost, but also received a huge increase in price for the worsened repairability).[/p][/*][*][p]The complexity of repairing reactors has been reduced from x3 to x2, due to problems with selling/buying prices, as well as the too high repair price, but in return, any improvements now give not +10% to the repair price, but +20%.[/p][/*][*][p]The sale price can no longer fall below 1 credit.[/p][/*][*][p]The visual size of asteroids has been reduced by 1.5 times.[/p][/*][*][p]The evasion of A-drones now depends on the evasion of the ship. Which resulted in up to a x3 reduction in hits on A-drones on evasive ships.[/p][/*][*][p]Simulations now restore the ship's structure level after exiting, as it was before entering them.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Quests[/h3][list][*][p]Added an alternative chain of quests for passage to In'Nefile.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an alternative quest for the Harvester's blueprints.[/p][/*][*][p]Added several quests for levels 8-14.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a second button for handing in items in the quest for more visibility.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]No longer displays compartments that cannot be built due to inappropriate station placement.[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer initiate an order to process ore if you do not have enough credits for the process (resulted in the disappearance of resources).[/p][/*][*][p]Now allows you to sell improved ships from the storage without entering an infinite confirmation loop.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more notifications about limitations/errors in stickers.[/p][/*][*][p]Changes to the C3 generator to prevent satellites from spawning inside planets.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the display of active boosters in the adv. information.[/p][/*][*][p]When changing ammo in the droid, the effect from them is now correctly displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]The problem with incorrect issuance of components from disassembly when using very small donors has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]The failure to take into account the decrease in control from removing the reactor to control has been fixed[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.9.12.0.0 Visual changes and armor rebalance
notes.notes:
[h2]New visual appearance[/h2][list][*][p]The appearance of the planets has been changed, and new visualization has been added for them: light, shadows, rings, atmosphere, heating.[/p][/*][*][p]The Sector 3 generator has been reworked to clean up the generation of systems where the orbits of the planets could intersect with each other due to the close position of the stars. Secondary stars no longer generate their own planets.[/p][/*][*][p]The map now shows an icon showing how many stars are in the system (up to 3).[/p][/*][/list][h3]
[/h3][h3]
Changes[/h3][list][*][p]The mechanics of armor and shields have been changed:[/p][list][*][p]Kinetic damage now ignores 50% of the shield;[/p][/*][*][p]Missile damage now ignores 25% of the shield, but armor protects against missiles twice as much.[/p][p]For example: with 20 ship armor, 40 missile damage is blocked.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Crystal plates effect rebalance. Now the damage to energy conversion takes into account not the damage result, but the absorbed damage. Thus, it is now possible to significantly increase the energy gain by the ship in cases where, with huge resistances, the ship received 0 damage, and therefore 0 energy as a result.[/p][p]As a result, the conversion was reduced from x2 to x0.3, which is significantly higher in terms of output than it was at high protection values.[/p][p]It is worth considering that although the absorption calculation occurs before the calculation of absolute armor, the energy is replenished [b]after[/b] receiving damage and spending energy on absolute armor.[/p][p]Before the changes:[/p][list][*][p]100 damage and 15% resistance = 85 damage and 25.5 energy from 30% conversion;[/p][/*][*][p]100 damage and 60% resistance = 40 damage and 20 energy from 120% (50% maximum) conversions;[/p][/*][*][p]100 damage and 90% resistance = 10 damage and 5 energy from 180% (50% max) conversion.[/p][/*][/list][p]After changes:[/p][list][*][p]100 damage and 15% resistance = 85 damage and 4.5 energy from absorption;[/p][/*][*][p]100 damage and 60% resistance = 40 damage and 18 energy from absorption;[/p][/*][*][p]100 damage and 90% resistance = 10 damage and 27 energy from absorption.[/p][/*][/list][p]Also, the maximum resistance of crystal armor has been raised from 50% to 60% due to the possibility of their improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The mechanics of the station hull have been fixed. The percentage of damage that hits the compartment inside is equal to the percentage of the station hull. With a station hull at 50%, half of the damage will go to the hull, and half will go further into the modules.[/p][p]Thus, stations have another full layer of protection, allowing you to save on shields during dangerous events.[/p][p] [/p][/*][*][p]Due to the addition of reactors, the industrial and corvet were given their own energy generation without a reactor (instead of slots for a reactor), since all small T1 ships have a reduced base energy generation, which greatly slows down player development in Sector 1, where there is no way to buy a reactor, as well as until you get ways to regenerate it.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Personal drops from bosses can no longer fall tethered more than 1 time to one person.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Personal items can now be deleted.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]No longer shows the inscription "transferred to storage" if there is nothing to transfer when completing a quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the display of quests with the issuance of stickers as a reward.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed replacing an item with a new one in the personal repair bay of the storage, which led to the loss of the item.[/p][/*][*][p]Not full pickup of an item now updates the size and quantity of the item for the client.[/p][/*][*][p]Switching visual modifications (stickers, skins) of other players is now applied immediately (without re-entering the location).[/p][/*][*][p]The achievement for obtaining a full aspect of improvement can no longer be completed by improving the aspect with a maximum below 10.[/p][/*][*][p]The achievement for all aspects no longer takes into account any improvements below level 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the inability to move in the arena due to the interface lock.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the lack of display of bullets for guns that receive the visual of their bullets from their ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]Now correctly updates the number of bots in the arena for everyone in sight when deleting a bot.[/p][/*][*][p]Caravan escorts who have fallen behind will now catch up with their target faster if they are far from it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the disappearance of credits for the transition to the ship at the station to nowhere.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the lack of advanced materials in the Leaping engine upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issuance of incorrect item in the main quests of the 1st sector for the Medramills.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.9.10.0.0 Battle Mechanics Changes: Part 2
notes.notes:
[h2]Battle Mechanics Changes: Part 2
[/h2][h3]Projectiles[/h3][list][*][p]All projectiles, as well as some guns, have been abolished and recreated in a new form[/p][/*][*][p]Now, every projectile that existed before is now a "basic" type of projectile. Such "basic" types of projectiles can be modified and created manually with the necessary modifiers in the future[/p][/*][*][p]Using different projectiles for a gun leads to changes in its personal stats too. With the right type of shells, you can significantly increase the damage, or add a shot effect for increasing the requirements of the gun itself[/p][/*][*][p]Ammo are automatically reloaded into the gun if you do not have the right shell inserted (in priority according to the list)[/p][/*][*][p]All ammo can now be created in the storage, having a Fabricator[/p][/*][/list][p]

[/p][h3]Weapons[/h3][list][*][p]Some guns have lost their features and have become "universal". Now weapon can have several possible variations of ammo for use. To load the desired type of ammo, simply move the item to the gun itself, and to remove it, click on the gun with the specified type of ammo while holding down the key for alternative item equipping (on mobile devices - simply click)[/p][/*][*][p]Due to the fact that guns can now have several types of ammo, the output of the ammo usage in the interface has changed[/p][/*][*][p]All modified parameters of the gun by its active ammo are directly shown in the information about the gun[/p][/*][*][p]The Smole and Acid variations of organic guns have been abolished. Now there is a single version of the "organic gun" (gun and, separately, a rocket launcher), which allows you to use both types of ammo. Weapon stats are designed to inherit the qualities of modularity from previous models[/p][/*][/list][p]

[/p][h3]Droids[/h3][list][*][p]All droids now consume ammo when firing, and also inherit skill requirements from the weapons inside (excluding CPU)[/p][/*][*][p]Droids can now use different types of ammo too (like their base weapon form)[/p][/*][*][p]Quests that give out drones now also give out shells[/p][/*][*][p]The chance of a drone applying a buff has been increased from 33% to 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Changes to individual drones:[/p][list][*][p][b]Bumblebee[/b][/p][p]Now uses an organic weapon that can load any capsules[/p][p][b]Price:[/b] 14000 => 15000[/p][p][b]Requirements[/b]: biochemistry 1 => 2[/p][/*][*][p][b]Corrosor[/b][/p][p]Now uses an Organic rocket launcher that can load organic rockets[/p][p]Since the weapon platform cannot contain such a huge weapon in terms of CPU - the radius of operation has been reduced by 2, along with damage by 25[/p][p][b]Price[/b]: 20000 => 36000[/p][p][b]Size[/b]: 24 => 32[/p][p][b]Energy consumption[/b]: 90 => 110[/p][p][b]Requirements[/b]: kinetics 1 => rocketry 2[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]

General changes[/h3][list][*][p]All SRL/ARL, SG/AG have been converted to updated versions[/p][/*][*][p]All modules that modify the effect of the gun now require this effect to be present (you cannot equip a module to improve the smole effect if the ammo on the gun is acidic). Modules that are not suitable for the projectile are disabled[/p][/*][*][p]If a modular weapon has disabled modules, this will now be visible by the faded and dark color of the stripes. Also, the information now shows which modules are disabled[/p][/*][*][p]Replicators now use the basic version of the projectile without modifications. The cartridge that is already inserted is taken as a priority for replication. Due to search restrictions, replicators require the player to have at least 1 ammo in the inventory in order to directly see what to copy from when logging into an account[/p][/*][*][p]Modular modelling (design canvas) now includes loading an ammo inserted into the gun[/p][/*][*][p]To change the number of guns in a ship's salvo, as well as the delay between salvos for more convenient play on guns with huge instant damage - go to the advanced information in the inventory. Also, you can cancel an attack right in the middle of other gun volleys, so as not to deal extra damage to an already obviously killed target. Also, an option to turn on/off such shooting directly in the active keys near the radar has been added
[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Now always takes at least 1 energy/credit from stations and storages when taking goods[/p][/*][*][p]Added a ship upgrade bay at the station. Requires the simultaneous presence of a hangar and a service bay for construction, with station location strictly in space. Does not require reputation when upgrading, but takes quite a lot of energy when upgrading (5k + 10k * ship tier). Allows you to make micro-improvements as well[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]C3 has been reduced by 20%, but the distances between subsectors have been increased for equal distance (so that you can't jump over)[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the reward for the quest for delivery from c2 to c3, as well as the cooldown from 4h to 3h[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Hybrid systems/navigations are now automatically placed in free secondary slots if the main ones are occupied[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Now you can change the color of nickname if you have premium active[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug with destroying an enemy several times, due to the fact that the remaining bullets reached him when he was already dead[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that did not give invulnerability to damage to an asteroid after its destruction (upon respawn)[/p][/*][*][p]Violation of the system law now only works in the system where the ship was hit, and not where the killer ship is currently located[/p][/*][*][p]Now you can see the damage to the station in the interface[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that did not allow ships to be upgraded, thanks to personal items that were in storage[/p][/*][*][p]Jump engine upgrades no longer consist of pure electronics[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that did not take into account hits on utility drones[/p][/*][/list]
